events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which quickly became the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Debut Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis unleashed 'Definitely Maybe' on the world. What's your favourite track from that game-changing debut?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 Years On
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, began on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for peace, love, and music. What's the one performance from Woodstock '69 you wish you'd seen live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing. The King of Rock 'n' Roll would have been 91. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year, was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, dying six days later.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1996, the hip-hop world lost a legend. Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55. His music and message live on.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 this year, passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. He would have been 84. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your favourite moment from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine turns 51 (UK Single Release)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975, four years after its US debut.

angles.name: Imagine Single Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as ever. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Today marks 25 years since Apple launched the original iPod. How many songs did yours hold, and what was on repeat?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is officially James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite Bond film or song?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What are your standout tracks from the double LP?
